description: Abstract base class for CLI clients interacting with Hono's AMQP adapter, providing connection and sender creation functionalities.

classes.name: AmqpCliClient
classes.description: Abstract class for CLI clients that connect to Hono's AMQP adapter, managing connections and senders.

methods.name: setClientConfig
methods.description: Sets the configuration properties for connecting to the AMQP adapter.

methods.name: createSender
methods.description: Creates an anonymous sender link on the established connection.

methods.name: connectToAdapter
methods.description: Establishes a connection to the AMQP adapter with appropriate security options.

methods.name: addTlsTrustOptions
methods.description: Configures TLS trust options for the client connection.
